recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical four-quadrant composition featuring two male subjects repeated vertically, flanking a central column of vertically stacked, condensed typography. The lighting is dramatic and directional, emerging from a deep black background to highlight facial features and white collars.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical symmetry between top and bottom portrait pairs
Central typographic spine acting as a divider
High contrast between dark background and bright facial highlights
Color-coded text hierarchy separating primary and secondary titles
coreInvariants: Subjects in formal attire (suits and white collars)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects positioned in the left and right thirds, mirrored vertically to fill all four corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central vertical text column serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top-left portrait, down the central text column, to the bottom-right portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant black background creates a 'void' effect, isolating the subjects and text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic font family with color differentiation for hierarchy.

preserve: Color contrast between white and olive

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and extreme condensation of the display text.
Captures the mid-century grotesque feel with narrow proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a four-quadrant portrait layout on a black background. Place a man with glasses on the left and a man without glasses on the right. Repeat this pair vertically so there are four heads total. Use dramatic, low-key lighting that highlights only the faces and white shirt collars, leaving the rest in deep shadow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a central column of text using an extra-condensed bold sans-serif font. The top half of the text should be white, and the bottom half should be olive green. Stack the words vertically and center-align them perfectly between the portraits.

verificationChecks: Is the text extra-condensed and center-aligned?
Does the text color change from white to olive green halfway down?
Is the lighting high-contrast and moody?

mustRedesign: Logos in the top left corner
Specific tracklist text at the bottom
Stereo branding at the top center
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the faces
Verify the olive green is muted and not neon
Check that the white collars are the brightest points in the image
Confirm the vertical alignment of the central text spine
recipe.reuseFormula: Take two portraits, duplicate them vertically into four quadrants, and bisect the composition with a vertical column of high-contrast, condensed typography.
